dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got any tricks of the trade to share?

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: If you want to learn about some special forging trick, then you've come to the wrong place.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Amenoma Art is different from the others. We don't have any secret forging tricks to offer. The only thing we can tell you is that you will need patience and the willpower to give everything you have.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Everyone who visits Amenoma Smithy has witnessed our skill in forging weapons. However, only very few have enough perseverance to carry on the spirit of the Amenoma Art.

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Tougo
dialogues.text: Only by creating a superior piece of work with relentless persistence and patience can you inherit the Amenoma name.
